relationships.subject: AGU661
relationships.evidence_quote: AGU661 effectively inhibits the enzyme activity of mPGES-1 in microsomes in a cell-free assay (IC50 = 0.22 nM)

relationships.subject: AGU661
relationships.evidence_quote: in M1-MDM that express high levels of COX-2 and mPGES-1, AGU661 reduced the massive PGE2 formation in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: AGU661
relationships.evidence_quote: also no effect on isolated COX-1 and COX-2 up to 1000 nM

relationships.subject: PLGA nanoparticles
relationships.evidence_quote: encapsulation of the mPGES-1 inhibitor AGU661 into PLGA-based NPs tremendously improves its potency in whole blood by more than 65-fold versus the free drug

key_findings: AGU661 selectively suppresses PGE2 in mPGES-1-expressing human M1 macrophages and LPS-stimulated monocytes without inhibiting COX-1/2.
PLGA encapsulation improved whole-blood potency (IC50 1.5 nM vs >100 nM free).
